transkript.t: Goldman Sachs just released a Quant Toolkit for anybody to use, and the best part is it's completely free.
It's a Python toolkit built to support workflows around derivatives, trading strategies, risk management, along with financial data analytics.
This open source is maintained by Quant developers who actually work at Goldman Sachs.
If you're an investor but not necessarily a Quant looking to incorporate more Quant techniques into your workflows,
all you need to do is pair this open source with Cloud or ChatGPT, and you can literally build out whatever you want in the Quant realm.
